point: 贡献一:把 DRL 确立为利用被动动力学生成多模态步态的有前景技术。
quote_en: The first contribution is that it established DRL as a promising technique for generating multimodal gaits using passive dynamics.

point: 贡献二:提出一个学习框架,只用一个速度参数、无需参考动作就训练出能在走/跑间切换的简单控制策略。
quote_en: The second contribution is that it presents a learning framework for training a simple control policy for a bipedal robot to switch between walking and running based on only a speed parameter without reference motion.

point: 髋关节是被动的,没有驱动器,控制器只能通过间接方式驱动身体动力学来摆腿前进。
quote_en: Notably, the hip joints are passive, i.e., they do not have actuators.

point: 每条腿有一个最大力为 F 的线性驱动器,沿腿轴上下移动大腿段;髋关节是带扭簧 k_hip 与阻尼 c_hip 的被动旋转关节。
quote_en: Each leg has a linear actuator with a maximum magnitude of force F that moves the thigh segment up and down along the leg axis

point: 胫骨处装有摆动质量(wobbling mass)机构,由三根线性弹簧(k1,k2,k3)、两个阻尼器(c1,c2)和一个质量(m_tibia)组成,用于减小落地冲击。
quote_en: consisting of three linear springs (k1, k2, k3), two dampers (c1, c2), and a mass (mtibia) was employed

point: 脚是半径 r=l/3 的弧形刚性脚,每只脚由 20 个小球构成。
quote_en: Each foot in the model consists of 20 small spheres.

point: 学习算法采用 SAC(soft actor-critic),一种用于连续控制的免模型 DRL 算法;动作 a_t∈R^2 是两条腿线性驱动器信号,各产生力 a_j·F。
quote_en: This study adopted a soft actor-critic (SAC) (Haarnoja et al., 2018b), which is a model-free DRL algorithm for continuous control tasks

point: 奖励函数第一项 -ω_E|E_t - E_{t-1}| 是对总能量变化的惩罚,抑制驱动器注入过多能量或落地损耗。
quote_en: The first term −ωE|Et − Et−1| represents the penalty for the total energy variation.

point: 整条奖励乘以系数 1/(1+ω_v),用于减小不同 ω_v 下奖励量级的差异(inter-reward variability)。
quote_en: 1/(1 + ωv) was set to reduce the inter-reward variability.

point: 当 |θ|>1.4 rad(即模型前后倾超过 80°)时本回合终止。
quote_en: The episode is terminated if |θ| > 1.4 rad, i.e., the model tilts by more than 80°

point: 受课程学习启发,把训练分成 LP1/LP2/LP3 三个阶段,逐阶段改变奖励权重与 ω_v 取值范围(见表2)。
quote_en: Learning was divided into three phases: "Learning Phase 1 (LP1)," "Learning Phase 2 (LP2)," and "Learning Phase 3 (LP3),"

point: 每个 epoch(=1000 个时间步)改变一次 ω_v 值进行训练。
quote_en: which was 1,000 time steps in this study

point: SAC 超参 α=0.2、γ=0.99;actor 与 critic 网络各有两层、每层 100 个节点。
quote_en: The neural networks used in the actor and critic had two hidden layers of 100 nodes.

point: 共训练 1000 万步:LP1 占前 50 万步、LP2 占接下来 250 万步、LP3 占剩余 700 万步。
quote_en: LP1 was performed in the initial 500 thousand time steps, LP2 in the next 2.5 million time steps, and LP3 in the remaining 7 million time steps

point: 回放缓冲取最近 100 万样本、mini-batch 256;每回合最长 1000 步;训练在一台 Lenovo ThinkPad E470 上约耗时 2 天。
quote_en: The time required for training was approximately 2 days on a Lenovo ThinkPad E470

point: 该双足模型实现的速度范围为 0.51 ≤ ẋ ≤ 3.02 m/s;0 ≤ ω_v ≤ 1.2 时观察到周期性双支撑(DS)相,整段范围内未观察到飞行(F)相。
quote_en: A periodic DS phase was observed for

point: 控制器在训练范围外的 ω_v∈[2.5,2.93] 仍能生成跑步步态。
quote_en: The controller generated a running gait for parameters ωv ∈ [2.5, 2.93] outside the training data.

point: ω_v=0 步态的动能与势能呈反相(out-of-phase),ω_v=2.5 步态在单支撑相呈同相(in-phase),与人类走/跑的能量相位特征一致。
quote_en: the gait generated for ωv = 0 exhibited an out-of-phase relationship between the kinematic and potential energies, whereas the gait generated for ωv = 2.5 exhibited an in-phase relationship in the single stance phase.

point: 按速度把步态分为走、过渡、跑三类(走 0.51–0.63 m/s、过渡 0.63–1.81 m/s、跑 ≥1.81 m/s),并用 Froude 数(Fr=ẋ/√(gl),范围 0.18–1.08)刻画。
quote_en: the Froude number (Fr) was 0.18

point: 走和过渡步态的能量变化量(VoE)随速度可用二次曲线拟合,跑步步态的 VoE 随速度近似线性(VoEr=0.00018x+0.00246)。
通过线性改变单一指令 ω_v 实现步态切换:走→跑在不到两步内完成,跑→走约需四步;还实现了 walk-to-run-to-walk 等多次切换。
quote_en: the transition from walking to running was successfully completed in less than two steps, whereas the transition from running to walking required approximately four steps.

point: 加高斯噪声鲁棒性测试:走与跑步态对 θ̇、φ、φ̇ 的噪声都较敏感,跑步步态还对 h 和 θ 的噪声脆弱。
quote_en: Both generated walking and running are susceptible to noise at θ̇, ϕ, and ϕ̇. Moreover, in the running gait, the bipedal model was vulnerable to noise at h and θ.

point: 噪声测试以走 10 m / 跑 20 m 不摔倒为成功,每种条件做 10 次试验。
quote_en: judged the success case when the bipedal model was able to move 10 m in the walking gait and 20 m in the running gait after noise was applied

point: 消融:去掉 1/(1+ω_v) 后(图13B),累计奖励训练 600 万步后掉到 0,约 700 万步变不稳、800 万步后摔倒。
quote_en: Figure 13B shows that the cumulative rewards gradually dropped to 0 after training for 6 million time steps.

point: 消融:不用 LP1 的 agent(图13F)无法找到稳定行走的控制解,从起点就摔倒。
quote_en: the agent trained without LP1 failed to find control solutions for steady locomotion; it fell from the start position.

point: 结论:LP1 是从零学到基本步态的必要阶段,LP2 是在已获步态上学到更稳定步态的必要阶段。
quote_en: LP1 is an essential phase for learning the basic gait pattern from an unlearned state, while LP2 is necessary for learning a more stable gait pattern from the initially acquired gait pattern.

point: 讨论:奖励第一项(能量变化惩罚)对生成连续运动至关重要;加入它之前找不到走/跑控制解,模型表现为非周期、速度不稳、易摔。
quote_en: Before this term was included, no control solutions were found for walking and running, and the bipedal model exhibited acyclic, velocity-unstable, and fall-prone movements.

point: 局限:本研究仅通过仿真验证;最大的差距是控制延迟——未考虑传感器、控制器、驱动器之间的时延。
quote_en: A major gap is control latency. In this study, we did not consider the time delay between the sensors, controller, and actuators.

point: 局限:模型运动只发生在向前直线方向,扩展到三维和改变运动方向留作未来工作。
quote_en: the bipedal model motion was achieved only in a forward straight line
